column1: # Claro-deployed vendor OUI blocks - PUBLIC IEEE registry data
# claro_wpa_key.py reads this to label a gateway's likely maker and to flag
# split-OUI units. Contribute a row via pull request - see CONTRIBUTING.md.
#   split   'yes' ONLY for the router-side OUI of a split-OUI gateway
#           Wi-Fi radio is a different block than the modem that keys the password
#           (so BSSID octet 3 is NOT the leading byte). Leave blank otherwise.
# --- Added 2026-09-04 from a metro WiGLE survey (deduped default-CLARO_ gateways).
#     OUI->vendor via the public IEEE registry (Wireshark manuf). Vendor labels only;
#     split-OUI status is unverified for these (can't be seen from a beacon)
